additional_info.subject: RE: ID0388721-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R7 170002202] HMI issue CRM:00643001049
additional_info.body:
Dear support,
We have checked on-site:
Check for any loose connections to the screen and board.
There are no loose wires, checked visually and manually pulling the wires.
Update the Dlogic firmware, if its not done in past.
Unfortunately I didn’t have the proper interface cables to check the firmware on-site.
Check for the 24VDC supply to the Dlogic board(PH2).
The voltage here seems fine – measured 24V.
Verify if the DP cables have been changed in the past with this charger. If not, we suggest replacing them with new DP cables.
There are shielded DP cables from the factory already applied.
So we are going to order a new black panel gen2 (
8EM5903-0AA04-0AA0
) + adaptation set (
8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6
).
Once we will perform the replacement I will let you know in this ticket.
Thank you for the support!
Best Regards
Tomas Cepicka
Siemens, s.r.o.
RC-CZ SI E CS
Siemensova 2715/1
155 00 Praha 13-Stodůlky
